label: post-comprehensive-wiring-audit-r162
context:
Completed R158-R162 training rounds. All wired into distillation plugin at ~/.hermes/plugins/distillation/__init__.py.

R158 — Next-State Signal Extractor (OpenClaw-RL): Extracts evaluative + directive signals from tool calls. Wired at post_tool_call after R156 decomposed reward block. Only stores non-empty directive hints.

R159 — ERL Heuristic Quality Reranker: Uses Phi-3 to score tips on trigger specificity + actionability. Runs every 200th tool call as background thread. Built at ~/subconscious/heuristic_reranker.py.

R160 — Turn-Level Credit Assignment (TIPS): Dense per-turn credit based on info gain, not just outcome. Tool type weighting (search > execution > write). Built at ~/subconscious/turn_credit.py.

R161 — Trajectory Intelligence Extractor (IBM Research): 3-type classification (strategy/recovery/optimization) + decision attribution. Only stores non-strategy patterns. Built at ~/subconscious/trajectory_intel.py.

R162 — Agentic RAG + synthesis tips: 7 tips from Agentic RAG survey (evaluator-optimizer pattern, explicit constraints, process evaluation, domain knowledge amplification, retrieval quality bottleneck).

- 1,091 active (conf >= 0.3), avg confidence 0.54
- Training domain: 41 tips, avg 0.83

- Local models: Phi-3 (8081), Llama 8B (8082), Nomic Embed (8083), MiniMax M2.7 (8084)
- VPS Hindsight: healthy, batch sync running
